name: Government of the Lao PDR
description: Supreme executive body of the Lao PDR, led by the Prime Minister; formed by the National Assembly.

name: President of Laos
aliases: President of the Lao People's Democratic Republic
description: Head of state of Laos; current president is Thongloun Sisoulith since 22 March 2021.

name: National Assembly of Laos
description: Supreme state organ of power of Laos; unicameral legislature, the only branch of government.

name: People's Supreme Court of Laos
description: Supreme judicial organ of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, established in 1982.

key_people.title: President of the People's Supreme Court
key_people.name: Phaivy Siboualipha

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for foreign affairs.

name: Ministry of National Defence
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for national defence.

name: Ministry of Public Security
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for public security.

name: Ministry of Finance
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for finance.

name: Ministry of Planning and Investment
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for planning and investment.

name: Ministry of Industry and Commerce
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for industry and commerce.

name: Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for agriculture and forestry.

name: Ministry of Education and Sports
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for education and sports.

name: Ministry of Health
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for health.

name: Ministry of Justice
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for justice.

name: Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for labour and social welfare.

name: Ministry of Information, Culture and Tourism
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for information, culture and tourism.

name: Ministry of Public Works and Transport
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for public works and transport.

name: Ministry of Energy and Mines
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for energy and mines.

name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for natural resources and environment.

name: Ministry of Technology and Communications
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for technology and communications.

name: Ministry of Home Affairs
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for home affairs.

name: Ministry of Science and Technology
description: Line ministry of the Government of Laos responsible for science and technology.

name: State Enterprise Reform Committee
description: Committee of the Lao government that received oversight of state-funded enterprises (state-owned and mixed-ownership) from the Ministry of Finance in October 2025.

name: Électricité du Laos
description: State corporation of Laos that owns and operates the country's electricity generation, transmission and distribution assets.

name: Lao Holding State Enterprise
description: State corporation of Laos primarily involved with financing of the energy industry, including the Nam Theun 2 Power Company.

name: Lao Airlines
description: Flag carrier of Laos, headquartered in Vientiane; operates domestic and international services.

name: Electrical Construction and Installation State Enterprise
aliases: Electrical Construction and Installation, State Enterprise
description: Lao state enterprise in electrical construction and installation.

name: Lao Brewery Company
description: Producer of beer, soft drinks and bottled drinking water in Laos, headquartered in Vientiane.

name: Lao Telecom
description: Telecommunications operator ranked as the largest company in Laos by revenue (USD 252.1M, ZoomInfo, September 2026). Ownership structure needs confirmation.

name: LVMC Holdings
description: Lao holding company (revenue about USD 180.8M per ZoomInfo, September 2026); majority owner of Indochina Bank.

name: Lao Skyway
description: Regional/domestic airline of Laos headquartered at Wattay International Airport, Vientiane (formerly Lao Air). Ownership is described as state-owned in one source and private in another; needs confirmation.

name: Nam Theun 2 Power Company
description: Company operating the Nam Theun 2 hydropower project (commercial operation since April 2010); one of Laos' major power exporters to Thailand.

name: Indochina Research
description: Market research company operating in Laos (also present in other Indochina markets).

name: ElefantAsia
description: Nonprofit organisation protecting the Asian elephant (Elephas maximus) in Laos.

name: Jhai Foundation
description: Non-profit organisation working mainly in Laos.

name: Participatory Development Training Centre
description: Lao civil society organization focused on participatory development.

name: Rural Development Agency
description: Lao nonprofit organization focused on rural development.

name: Lao Conservation Trust for Wildlife
description: NGO in Laos that rescues, rehabilitates and releases native wildlife affected by illegal trade.

name: Association for Rural Mobilisation and Improvement
description: Nonprofit working to reduce poverty by improving food security, health, education and inclusive community development.

name: Global Association for People and the Environment
description: Lao nonprofit organization focused on environment protection.

name: Lao CSO Platform
description: Network of Civil Society Organizations in the Lao PDR promoting SDGs and the National Socio-economic Development Plan.

name: iNGO Network in the Lao PDR
description: Network of International NGOs in the Lao PDR, established in 2005, facilitating liaison and collaboration among INGOs and development partners.

name: Plan International Laos
description: Country office of Plan International supporting vulnerable children and adolescents, especially girls.

name: National University of Laos
description: National public university in Vientiane, founded in 1996.

name: Souphanouvong University
description: Public university located in Luang Prabang, Laos.

name: Lao University of Health Sciences
description: University of health sciences in Laos.

name: Champasak University
description: University in Champasak province, southern Laos.

name: Savannakhet University
description: University in Savannakhet, Laos.

name: Sisavangvong University
description: University in Vientiane established in 1958 and named after King Sisavangvong; ceased after 1975.

name: Lao National Science Council
description: National science council of Laos.

name: Lao News Agency
description: Official news agency of the Lao government and the ruling party, established 1968.

name: Lao National Television
description: National television station of Laos, broadcasting since 1 December 1983; operates channels LNTV1 and LNTV3.

name: Vientiane Times
description: Bilingual English and Lao daily newspaper published in Vientiane, established 1994 as a weekly by Lao Press in Foreign Languages.

name: Pasaxon
description: Weekly newspaper established 13 August 1950; official organ of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party.

name: Le Rénovateur
description: Only French-language newspaper in the Lao PDR, published weekly by the Lao Press in Foreign Languages.

name: Vientiane Mai
description: Lao-language state-run daily newspaper.

name: Pathet Lao (newspaper)
description: Lao-language newspaper; the title is shared with the name of the historical Pathet Lao movement.

name: Laotian Times
description: English-language news outlet in Laos.

name: Lao Star TV
description: Lao private television channel billing itself as a television for the new generation.

name: Big Brother Mouse
description: Not-for-profit publishing project in Laos.

name: Lao Phattana News
description: Lao-language news outlet listed among Lao newspapers.

name: Bank of the Lao P.D.R.
description: Central bank of Laos; controls the money supply, manages reserves and supervises commercial banks.

name: Banque pour le Commerce Extérieur Lao
aliases: Banque pour le Commerce Exterieur Lao Public
description: Government-owned commercial/specialized bank in Laos (established 1975).

name: Lao Development Bank
description: Government-owned bank in Laos; joint venture of Chaleun Sekong Group and the Lao government (established 2003).

name: Agricultural Promotion Bank
description: Government-owned commercial/specialized bank in Laos (established 1993).

name: Nayoby Bank
description: Specialized (policy) government-owned bank in Laos (established 2006).

name: Lao-Viet Bank
description: Joint venture between BCEL and BIDV (Vietnam).

name: Banque Franco-Lao
description: Joint venture between BCEL and BRED (France), established October 2008.

name: Lao China Bank
description: Joint venture between BCEL and Fudian Bank (China).

name: Joint Development Bank
description: Private commercial bank in Laos, majority-owned by Simuong Group.

name: Phongsavanh Bank
description: Private commercial bank in Laos, majority-owned by Phongsavanh Group.

name: Indochina Bank
description: Lao private bank; described as Laos' largest private sector lender by assets.

name: ST Bank
description: Private commercial bank in Laos, majority-owned by ST Group.

name: Bank for Investment and Commerce
description: Private commercial bank in Laos, majority-owned by AIF Group.

name: Maruhan Japan Bank Lao
description: Private commercial bank in Laos, majority-owned by Maruhan.

name: Booyoung Lao Bank
description: Private commercial bank in Laos, majority-owned by Booyoung Group.

name: Lao Securities Exchange
description: Primary stock exchange of Laos, located in the capital Vientiane.

name: Lao People's Revolutionary Party
description: Founding and sole ruling party of the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

name: Lao Front for National Development
description: Laotian popular front founded in 1979, led by the Lao People's Revolutionary Party; organizes mass mobilization.

name: Committee for the Defence of the National Interests
description: Conservative historical party, founded 1958; no longer active.

name: National Progressive Party (Laos)
description: Historical political party in the kingdom of laos; no longer active.

name: Lao Neutralist Party
description: Historical neutralist party associated with souvanna phouma; no longer active.

name: Peace and Neutrality Party
description: Historical political party in the kingdom of laos; no longer active.

name: Lao People's Rally
description: Historical political party in the kingdom of laos; no longer active.

name: Lao National Union Party
description: Historical political party in the kingdom of laos; no longer active.

name: Independent Party (Laos)
description: Historical political party in the kingdom of laos; no longer active.

name: Democratic Party (Laos)
description: Historical political party founded 1951; no longer active.

name: Youth Movement (Laos)
description: Historical political movement/party in the kingdom of laos; no longer active.

name: Association of Northern Deputies
description: Historical political association/party in the kingdom of laos; no longer active.

name: Lao Development Association
description: Historical political association/party in the kingdom of laos; no longer active.

name: Mekong River Commission
description: Intergovernmental organization HQ in Vientiane facilitating regional cooperation for sustainable water resource management in the Lower Mekong Basin.

name: Lao People's Armed Forces
description: Combined military forces of Laos and the military institution of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party.
